verdict.rationale: Persona's docs list Watchlist, Politically Exposed Person, and Adverse Media among its report types, and its API orchestrates Watchlist and PEP reports. Workflows can run reports automatically alongside an inquiry, and results can be reviewed in Accounts and the Cases ops UI, so screening, verification and review sit with one vendor and one API. Missing for 10: explicit mention of sanctions lists by name (only 'Watchlist'), detail on reviewing and resolving watchlist hits within Cases, adverse-media coverage beyond a list mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
